reasoning: Following the withdrawal of Democratic nominee David Roth on July 28, 2026, Republican incumbent Jim Risch faces independent Todd Achilles in the general election. While Achilles' campaign points to a spring poll showing a competitive head-to-head, a June Peak Insights poll showed Risch leading Achilles by 48 points in a one-on-one matchup and leading the full field 55% to 7%. Backed by a $3.3 million war chest compared to Achilles' $692,000, Risch holds a commanding advantage in this heavily Republican state.
